articleTitle: The Matlab/Simulink modeling and numerical simulation of an analogue capacitive micro-accelerometer. Part 2: Closed loop
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The paper describes the closing of the loop for an analogue capacitive micro-accelerometer. The accelerometer is mathematical modeled, the mathematical relation being expressed both in complex domain and in time. Through equations linearization are made appreciations relative to the system quality in frequencies domain. Because of the great nonlinearities present in system at the level of capacitive transducer, to extend the utilization domain of the accelerometer, we need to close his loop. In the micro-accelerometers case, as a feedback force usually is used an electrostatics force. To improve the dynamical characteristics of the accelerometer the feedback voltage is taking from a regulator mounted on the direct way of the accelcrometer, after demodulator. The regulator type is established using the transfer function of the linearized system. Also, his tuning is made using the minimum error surface criteria Ziegler-Nichols and the numerical simulation. Finally, the dynamical performances of the closed loop accelerometer are tested and discussed with respect to the performances of open loop accelerometer.

articleTitle: Application of image processing and analysis in selected industrial computer vision systems
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Computer industrial applications are integral part of nowadays measurement systems. In this article two different industrial applications of vision systems were described. The first one - "Yarn hairiness analyzer" measures the real length of the fibers protruding from the yearn core. "Thermo-Wet" - the second application, determines surface properties of metals in high temperatures. Due to use of innovative solutions, especially application of image processing and analysis algorithms, the original results were achieved. They reflect real values of measured properties. The significance of image segmentation quality in both considered applications was explained. The universal image segmentation algorithm was introduced. It can be successfully used in both considered applications.

articleTitle: A dynamic K-winners-take-all analog neural circuit
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Continuous time mathematical model of K-winners-take-all (KWTA) neural circuit which can quickly identify the K-winning from N neurons, where 1 les, K <N, whose input signals are larger than of remaining N - K neurons, are proposed. A functional block diagram of corresponding analog neural circuit is presented. For N competitors, such circuit is composed of N feedforward and one feedback hardlimiting neurons, which is used to determine the dynamic shift of input signals. There has been shown that the proposed circuit is simpler and presents more high speed of signal processing than existing analogs.

articleTitle: Neurolike networks on the basis of Geometrical Transformation Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The new universal concept's fundamentals of the construction and noniterative training of the neurolike modeling aids on the basis of tabular data, which are oriented on solving of the wide range of intelligent data analysis problems, specifically for build-in environment in MEMS design branch, are being reviewed.

articleTitle: The algorithms of the yarn shape detection and calculation of the protruding fibres length
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The article presents a description of original algorithms invented by the author: yarn shape detection and calculation of the protruding fibers length.

articleTitle: Possibilities of the use of genetic algorithms in design of MEMS elements
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper parallel optimization of constituent parts by a MEMS genetic algorithm is considered.

articleTitle: Reliability in MEMS and mechanical fatigue tests on gold micro-structures
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The mechanical fatigue behavior of MEMS gold structures is analyzed. Preliminary numerical FEM simulations are performed to determine the tension level in the material for a certain actuation voltage. Experimental tests are performed in order to monitor the damage accumulation during loading cycles; fatigue effect on material is evaluated through the monitoring of the pull-in voltage of the device.

articleTitle: The generalized technique of computation the discrete harmonic transforms
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The efficient computation of discrete harmonic transforms is introduced. The algorithm of computation are determined the structure of discrete basis matrix. The symmetrical cyclic convolutions is fundamental of algorithm for computation discrete harmonic transform.

articleTitle: Drop shape analysis for measurements of surface tension and wetting angle of metals at high temperatures
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: New metal's drop shape analysis algorithms are presented in this paper. They concerns utilization of digital image processing and analysis methods in process of wetting tension and contact angle measurements at high temperatures.

articleTitle: VHDL-AMS model of mechanical elements of MEMS tuning fork gyroscope for the schematic level of computer-aided design
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Iii the paper VHDL-AMS model for computer- aided design of MEMS tuning fork gyroscope has been created. The created model allows to model drive and sense vibrations, variations of Coriolis acceleration, capacitance and current changes of the device depending on the applied angular velocity, and also to make its functioning analysis on the schematic level of computer- aided design.

articleTitle: Edge detection in brain images
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper problem of edge detection in digital images is considered. Particular attention is paid to brain magnetic resonance images. The new approach to edge detection is introduced. Results of proposed method are presented and compared with traditional approach.

articleTitle: Using circuit design software to simulate mechanical components
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper the possibility of using circuit design software to simulate mechanical components is considered.

articleTitle: Automated vehicles for physically and visually challenged
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Of late road traffic becomes congested and unmanageable. Notwithstanding the fact that government takes all steps to reduce congestion, in view of increasing two wheelers, four wheelers not to speak of autos, all important roads are abound with vehicles. Further, many persons do not drive with diligent-neither they think of themselves nor of others. In the circumstances, it is of dire need that with the available infrastructure we should do something for the benefit of the society as a whole. In this context we have developed a mechanism of fuzzy logic which reduces the accidents and also helps for physically/visually challenged persons. The proposed system will reduce the accidents by neighboring vehicle detection, obstacle detection, controlling the vehicle speed, traffic light detection and signboard detections. All these above mentioned facilities are automated (i.e.) with out any human interventions. One of the main advantages of our system is that we don't need to replace the existing vehicles, placing the circuit in speedometer is enough. Another main advantage is that the same circuit that we have designed can also be extended to defence, space research, wheel chairs etc..

articleTitle: On graph isomorphism determining problem
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The problems of determining the graph isomorphism on the base of optimal reduction tree is considered.

articleTitle: A description of electrostatic ring gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper deals with modeling and simulation of electrostatic gyroscope using multidisciplinary computer aided design system ANSYS. Investigation concerning force and displacements are carried out.

articleTitle: Application of space domain integral equation technique for high frequency description of open microstrip discontinuities
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The full-wave electrodynamical analysis of the open microwave discontinuities is performed by the space domain integral equation approach. This approach employs the dyadic Green's functions for a grounded multi-layer dielectric configuration and can be used on a single or multi-layer dielectric with or without superstrate. The method of moments is used for numerical solving the received equation. Elements of respective impedance matrix are calculated by combination of analytical and numerical integration. The characteristic network parameters of structure are determined on the know matrix elements.

articleTitle: The reliability analysis of thermal design software system
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: For the software reliability testing the model of software reliability estimation, which is based on the random Poisson process, has been used, which determines and allows to forecast the software fault probability and its reliability in the set moment of time. The software environment of computer-aided testing for the verification of computational software for the solution of thermal conductivity problems has been developed. Keywords - software reliability,

articleTitle: VHDL-AMS — model for capacitive interdigital accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, is developed VHDL-AMS model for capacitive microaccelerometer of IDT construction for design on the schematic design level. Presented analysis results of the developed model.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of piezoelectric MEMS accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper mathematical model of the piezoelectric accelerometer based on unimorph cantilever beam 31 direction was considered. Numerical verification of the mathematical model was performed.

articleTitle: The segmentation of meristematic Allium cell images and extraction of nuclei features for the purpose of mitotic index evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper presents the segmentation method of Allium cell images preceding the extraction of nuclei features that are capable to distinguish interphase and mitotic events. The segmentation consists in the isolation of cell regions and then local edge-based thresholding of nuclei parts including the corrections of observed artefacts. The ability of the separation of mitotic phases groups was tested for the nuclei textural and shape features using information gain ratio and Bayesian classification error.

articleTitle: Machine vision - automation of selected measurement systems
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this article structural aspects of two different vision systems were described. The systems automatically measures respectively: surface properties of metals and yarn hairiness. Despite of so different fields of science there are common stages in all these measurements processes. Having this in mind, in the article authors defined main stages of the considered' measurement processes including image acquisition, image enhancement, image segmentation and image analysis.

articleTitle: Some trends in Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper focuses on some trends in Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining in Databases. We consider links between data mining, knowledge discovery and artificial intelligence. We then define basic concepts of the KDD process.

articleTitle: Transport motion model in intensive traffic flow
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The model for the transport motion description in the intensive traffic flow is considered in this work. The suggested model and technical means provide automated solution to the complicated task of overtaking when driving in the intensive traffic flow.

articleTitle: The method for automated design of VHDL-AMS models of MEMS elements on circuit level
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A method is offered to increase the level of automation of process of VHDL-AMS - models design of MEMS element operating under different physical laws and effects.

articleTitle: Algorithms for finding price-optimal way to lay pipes and their applications for MEMS
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Laying pipes and designing MEMS seem like totally different tasks, but on the algorithmic level, the same or very similar algorithms may be used in both of them. The task of laying a pipe is very similar to the one where you have to design a chip. Even in big-sized chips, the wires may not be laid by random, as due to the electromagnetic interferences, this would significantly decrease the performance of the chip. In microchips the problem is even more difficult to solve, as starting by some size you start to deal with quantum effects.

articleTitle: Applications of the ideal ring bundles theory for combinatorial optimization of coded design and electronic engineering
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Both the "ordered chain" and the "ordered ring" approach to the study of elements and events is known to be of widespread applicability, and has been extremely effective when applied to the problem of finding the optimum ordered arrangement of structural elements in spatially or temporally distributed systems [1]-[7]. This approach involves techniques based on the mathematical apparatus of Ideal Ring Bundles theory (IRB theory) for improving the quality indices of radio electronic engineering and designed systems with ring structure with respect to transmission speed, resolving ability, performance reliability, using design techniques based on the idea of "perfect" ring order and new conceptual models of the systems based on the idea of "perfect" combinatorial construction. The IRB theory can be used to finding optimal design for wide classes of technological problems in electronic and radio electronic engineering based on combinatorial techniques.

articleTitle: Circuit board image analysis by clustering
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: One of the possible ways of decompose and formalize visual images is to break them down into correct geometric figures and integrating the latter into fragments of the image. The article is dedicated to development and study of the algorithm for covering images with rectangles and region of rectangles for criteria, the parameters of which can be managed by user. Possible practical applications of these parameters management are also considered.

articleTitle: Creation of design algorithm of working elements of micromechanical gyroscopes
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, the mathematical model of vibrations of the micromechanical gyroscope and the design algorithm of the constructive parameters of its working elements are proposed.

articleTitle: Innovative transformations of industrial enterprises structure
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The analysis of processes is presented, that take place during functioning of production enterprise. The scenario of loop of quality is reproduced by ISO 9001 standard in a sectional kind. The matrix of connections is built.

articleTitle: Modeling indices of reliability for ramified embedded systems
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A method of investigation of reliability indices for ramified systems by means of generating functions is developed taking account of aging of the system's output elements. Main reliability indices of ramified embedded systems are examined in this paper.

articleTitle: New segmentation algorithms of metal’s drop images from thermo-wet system
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper new metal's drop image segmentation algorithms are presented. They concern utilization of digital processing and analysis of drop images at high temperatures in a process of wetting tension and contact angle measurements.

articleTitle: Organizational and technical framework for conflicts resolution in collaborative CAD systems
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The process of collaborative engineering design is relatively complex, and often results in various conflicts due to technical and social factors. This paper provides an architecture for analyzing collaborative design process and conflict based on a Organizational & Technical design framework.

articleTitle: Research of a thermoelasticity of semiconducting microstructures
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In paper the outcomes of research of a thermoelasticity of semiconducting structures MEMS represented. The analytical model for research of a thermoelasticity of microstructures designed.

articleTitle: Principals of functioning of two-channel analysing system
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The structure of the two-channel difference analyzing system is presented for monitoring of environment, the algorithm of its functioning is considered and the adaptive algorithm of work of the system and algorithm of its teaching is proposed.

articleTitle: The main points of the microelectromechanical systems development
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the basic MEMS structure and main development problems are considered. It's also accented on the design of the most used types of MEMS parts and the most popular MEMS applications are mentioned. In this paper the main points and tasks of the microelectromechanical systems development are described.

articleTitle: Algorithms and analysis of input data for the task of build of the circuitries reduction tree
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The main features of algorithm realization of tree built by the optimum reduction are considered and made the analysis of entrance data.

articleTitle: Analysis of the linear acceleration measurement methods
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the methods for measuring the linear acceleration were analyzed. Given the defects list per each method.

articleTitle: Computer-based system for non-contact temperature measurement of high-glittering induction-heated rotating steel cylinder
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Induction heated rotating steel cylinders are mainly used in paper-making, textile and chemical industry. Low emissivity and moving surface are the main difficulty of temperature measurement in this kind of devices. In the paper the real-size induction heated rotating steel cylinder has been described. Additionally, it has been used to investigating the possibility of using the infra-red thermocouples to non-contact temperature measurement. The influence of emissivity varying for temperature readings has been described and the methods of reduction disadvantageous phenomenon has been proposed.

articleTitle: Design of analog phase shifters of harmonic signals
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Mathematical models and corresponding functional diagrams of analog phase shifters of harmonic signals are proposed. The models and diagrams are precise for any finite values of input signals. Amplitude of output signals and phase shift between input and output signals of such diagrams are independent on a frequency, a signal transformation is fulfilled linearly without amplitude and frequency distortion. Derived circuits do not need fulfilling additional filtering of output signals.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of technical characteristics of micromechanical z-axis gimbaled gyroscope using VHDL-AMS
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, a model for computer-aided design of the micromechanical z-axis gimbaled gyroscope has been created using VHDL-AMS. The created model allows to model drive and sense vibrations, current changes, output voltage, sensitivity of the device depending on the applied angular velocity, and also to make the functioning analysis of such device on the schematic level of computer-aided design.

articleTitle: The Matlab/Simulink modeling and numerical simulation of an analogue capacitive micro-accelerometer. Part 1: Open loop
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The paper deal with an open loop analogue capacitive micro-accelerometer both from the point of view of mathematical modeling and through the achievement of certain numerical simulations which must confirm the mathematical models and in the same time help to establish the optimal architecture of the system. The capacitive transducer is one of differential type, with two fixed plates and one moving, which play the role of proof mass. Structure of the system contains the proper transducer and an electronic device (charge amplifier + phase-sensitive demodulator) to process the signal obtained from transducer. The accelerometer is mathematical modeled, the mathematical relation being expressed both in complex domain and in time. The mathematical modeling contains two distinct phases: the modeling of the proper accelerometer, which includes the proof mass and elastic element, and the modeling of the differential capacitive transducer for the proof mass displacements. Using these mathematical relations, the block schemas are realized for each block separately and for the full system. Starting from the numerical values of the accelerometer's parameters the numerical simulations with programming MATLAB/SIMULINK are made for each of the deduced block schemas.
